recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: an AI model closing a thirty-year math gap with a single prompt
Stack Overflow's traffic falling away in one steep graph
San Francisco summer morning at thirteen degrees, mostly clear
design circles debating why every AI logo looks the same
long July evenings stretching past eight-thirty

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beat drops in sync with fog banks rolling over Golden Gate silhouettes — miss a beat and the bass cuts out.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 30-second round builds one perfect drop to a full chorus hit.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and off-beat ghost notes appear to throw timing.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe over SF summer fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort floating geometric constraints into a convex hull before the optimization timer collapses — one prompt, one solution.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: drag shapes into valid hull regions
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Mismatched pieces snap into an elegant solution in under a minute.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Constraint rules multiply and the hull shrinks each round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: chalkboard topology diagrams with hand-drawn vectors

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous path connecting orphaned code snippets before Stack Overflow's declining traffic line swallows your nodes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: draw a path connecting scattered nodes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Completing a circuit just before the graph line drops below you.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Nodes scatter faster and dead-end forks multiply.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: retro terminal green on black with a falling line graph overlay

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick yacht-rock vinyl discs across a summer deck to land in Fleetwood Mac-themed slots while Enya wind chimes sway off course.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: One perfect ricochet into the center slot with a vinyl crackle payoff.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Orinoco-style wind gusts push discs off the deck edges.
